message.content:
{"diagnosis": "TRAP asserted on legal NOPs (ADDI) with tohost FAIL 0xdead and no fetch progress per picosoc/picosoc.v:146 cpu. instr_trap was 1 instead of 0 for recognized opcodes. Root cause at picorv32.v:679 the gate `assign instr_trap = (CATCH_ILLINSN || WITH_PCPI) || !{...}` uses outer OR so it forces trap high even when valid; it must be AND.", "patch_diff": "diff --git a/picorv32.v b/picorv32.v
--- a/picorv32.v
+++ b/picorv32.v
@@ -679,1 +679,1 @@
-	assign instr_trap = (CATCH_ILLINSN || WITH_PCPI) || !{instr_lui, instr_auipc, instr_jal, instr_jalr,
+	assign instr_trap = (CATCH_ILLINSN || WITH_PCPI) && !{instr_lui, instr_auipc, instr_jal, instr_jalr,
", "expected": "tohost PASS, TRAP deasserted with fetch progress"}

diagnosis: TRAP asserted on legal NOPs (ADDI) with tohost FAIL 0xdead and no fetch progress per picosoc/picosoc.v:146 cpu. instr_trap was 1 instead of 0 for recognized opcodes. Root cause at picorv32.v:679 the gate `assign instr_trap = (CATCH_ILLINSN || WITH_PCPI) || !{...}` uses outer OR so it forces trap high even when valid; it must be AND.
